Players master wall runs and mid-air jumps to collect hidden scrolls and reach checkpoints before time runs out. The challenge grows as levels introduce more complex layouts and enemy types, testing agility and strategy.

Key Features

• precision timing for obstacle navigation  
• wall run and double jump mechanics  
• timed checkpoint progression system  
• hidden collectible scrolls  
• diverse enemy avoidance tactics

pages.title: Ninja Ranmaru
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Control a stealthy ninja using precise timing to navigate rooftops and defeat enemy samurai in this side-scrolling action game. Players rely on swift shuriken throws and katana strikes to overcome waves of foes and advance through increasingly dangerous levels. The game blends traditional Japanese settings with agile movement mechanics that challenge reaction speed and strategy.

Key Features

• Precision timing stealth mechanics  
• Shuriken and katana combat system  
• Rooftop platforming progression  
• Enemy samurai wave challenges  
• Classic Edo period atmosphere

pages.title: Ninja Room Escape
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description:
Navigate intricate puzzles and search for hidden clues to break free from locked environments using stealth and observation skills. This escape experience challenges players to decode secret passages and manipulate objects to unlock the path out. Progression depends on uncovering clever interactions within compact, room-based levels.

Key Features

• Puzzle-solving with interactive objects  
• Context-sensitive stealth mechanics  
• Layered clue discovery system  
• Sequential room unlocking progression  
• Atmospheric indoor setting

pages.title: Rope Ninja
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description:
Swing across urban rooftops using precise rope mechanics to navigate obstacle-filled levels. Players time their swings to gain momentum and avoid hazards while aiming to complete challenging courses. Mastering the grappling hook's timing is essential to advance through increasingly complex stages filled with dynamic movement puzzles.

Key Features

• Rope swing physics mechanics  
• Player momentum control system  
• Progressive level difficulty scaling  
• Obstacle timing and avoidance  
• Urban rooftop traversal setting
